newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise Assisted files for 5 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise Assisted files for 5 mln shr offer.

text.p: Sunrise Assisted Living Inc said on Tuesday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a five million share public secondary offering.
The company, which provides assisted living services to the elderly, said it would offer four million shares and certain shareholders would offer the other one million shares.
Sunrise said it expected to use its net proceeds to finance the development and acquisition of additional assisted living facilities and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
